notes: Rapid+ Pro is gone: every feature, including unlimited profiles and the ad & tracker blocker, is now free for everyone, with no subscription and no account needed. Fixed "For you" feed thumbnails and refreshing for new stories. Added an optional daily digest notification and an in-app media downloader, both off by default in Settings. Removed account sign-in and cross-device sync, so Rapid+ now stays fully on your device.

desktop.notes: Rapid+ is now free for everyone, no account or sign-in needed. New: ad & tracker blocker, a For You content feed, a daily digest notification, per-profile PIN lock, scheduled auto-clear, media downloads, a connection-security indicator with Proceed Anyway, removable Most Visited tiles, and reopen closed tab (Ctrl+Shift+T).
